units.source_text: 就选定了一个黄道吉日，悄悄地命人准备一切应有事宜。

en.t: So an auspicious day was chosen, and people were quietly ordered to prepare everything that would be needed.

units.source_text: 明石姬到底舍不得放弃这孩子。

en.t: Lady Akashi still could not bear to give up the child.

units.source_text: 但念孩子的前程要紧，也只得忍受痛苦。

en.t: But thinking that the child's future mattered most, she had no choice but to endure the pain.

units.source_text: 不但孩子而已，乳母也非同去不可。

en.t: It was not only the child; the nurse had to go with her as well.

units.source_text: 多年以来，她与这乳母晨昏相伴，忧愁之日，寂寞之时，全靠二人互相慰藉。

en.t: For many years she and this nurse had been together morning and evening, and in days of sorrow and times of loneliness they had relied entirely on comforting each other.

units.source_text: 如今这乳母也走了，她更形孤单，安得不伤心痛哭？

en.t: Now that even this nurse was leaving, she felt lonelier than ever; how could she not weep in heartbreak?

units.source_text: 乳母安慰她道：“这也是前定之事。

en.t: The nurse comforted her, saying, "This too was destined beforehand.

units.source_text: 我因意外之缘，幸得侍奉左右。

en.t: Through an unexpected bond, I was fortunate enough to serve at your side.

units.source_text: 多年以来，常感盛情，念念不忘，岂料有分手之日？

en.t: For many years I have always felt your deep kindness and never forgotten it; how could I have imagined a day of parting would come?

units.source_text: 虽然今后会面机会甚多，但一旦离去左右，前往逢迎素不相识之人，心中好生不安呵！”

en.t: Although there will be many chances to meet in the future, once I leave your side and go to attend people I have never known, I feel terribly uneasy!"
As she said this, she too began to cry.
